newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Strike at ERPM gold mine - Randgold.
newsitem.headline: Strike at ERPM gold mine - Randgold.

text.p: Workers have gone on strike at South Africa's East Rand Proprietary Mines Ltd on Tuesday over retrenchment conditions at the Benoni Gold division, mine managers Randgold and Exploration Co Ltd said.

The strike has hit the Benoni Gold processing plant, which was bought by ERPM late last year and is set to see a wave of lay-offs, the National Union of Mineworkers (NUM) said in a separate statement.
ERPM and the the NUM have failed to reach agreement on issues surrounding the retrenchment talks, Randgold said.
The firm added that it is seeking an urgent interdict in the labour court to end the strike.
ERPM posted an underground output of 1,892 kilogrammes of gold for the three months to end-December.
